description.short_caption: Abdominal MRI with contrast showing liver lesions.
description.detailed_description: This is a contrast-enhanced abdominal MRI image focusing on the liver. The liver demonstrates multiple hyperintense lesions, with one lesion prominently marked by an arrow. The lesions appear irregular and are suggestive of abscesses or other focal pathology. The surrounding liver parenchyma shows normal signal intensity. The image is taken in an axial plane.

description.short_caption: Ultrasound showing an enlarged right submandibular lymph node measuring 2.86 cm by 1.59 cm.
description.detailed_description: This sagittal ultrasound image depicts an enlarged lymph node in the right submandibular region. The node is oval-shaped with well-defined borders and measures 2.86 cm in length and 1.59 cm in width, as indicated by the measurement markers. The echotexture appears heterogeneous, with some hypoechoic areas visible. The surrounding tissue shows no obvious abnormalities.
visible_findings: dimensions marked as 2.86 cm by 1.59 cm

description.short_caption: Abdominal MRI with contrast showing liver lesions.
description.detailed_description: This is a contrast-enhanced axial abdominal MRI image. The liver is prominently visualized, and there are multiple hypodense lesions (arrows) within the liver parenchyma. These lesions appear irregular and may suggest abscesses or other focal hepatic pathology. The surrounding abdominal structures are less prominently visualized.
